red_control_lineage: Reuses full-environment trial’s failing baseline frame-allocation control, on identical baseline source and identical test body. The ablation passes that control.
integration_note: Unconfigured integration test, not corpus qualification. Four ignored doctests.

first_cost_trial.boundary: Raw process status; software guest instructions are not an official Arena score.

counter_boundary: One observation per arm and case, generic x86-64 software guest instructions. Explicit 60-second process cap.
tradeoff: Magma pair n7 about 25% fewer instructions; fueled chain about 30% more. This is not a general speedup or a ranking claim.
authorship: Independently authored ablation; no competitor implementation copied.

repeated_cost_trial.boundary: Raw process status; software guest instructions are not an official Arena score.

repeat_boundary: Two observations per arm and input in an additional paired run with order reversed in the second round. All 20 accepted; same large workload tradeoff remains.

portable.boundary: Raw status on attempted portable inputs. Explicit exclusions remain unknown. No ten-large-input qualification.
